info.name: Revivo
info.description: Project-wide Revivo API collection. Configure the local environment and run the HTTPS launch profile. Trust the local development certificate in Postman. Registration requests create persistent test accounts; duplicate registration creates a separate fixture. testPassword is optional and is never stored in this collection.

exec: if (models.length) { const model = models[0]; pm.collectionVariables.set('carModelId', String(model.id)); const year = Math.min(model.yearEnd || new Date().getFullYear(), new Date().getFullYear() + 1); pm.collectionVariables.set('carImageYear', String(Math.max(model.yearStart || year, year))); }

request.description: Set makeId to an existing make ID; saves the first returned model ID. Optional search query filters model names.

exec: pm.test('Years returned in descending order', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const years = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(years).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(years).to.deep.equal([...years].sort((a,b) => b-a)); });

exec: pm.test('Found photos include hotlinked URL and attribution', () => { if (image.status === 'found') { pm.expect(image.imageUrl).to.match(/^https:\/\/images\.unsplash\.com\//); pm.expect(image.photographerName).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; [image.photographerUrl, image.photoUrl, image.unsplashUrl].forEach(url => { pm.expect(url).to.include('utm_source=revivo'); pm.expect(url).to.include('utm_medium=referral'); }); } else { pm.expect(image.imageUrl).to.equal(null); pm.expect(image.photographerName).to.equal(null); pm.expect(image.photographerUrl).to.equal(null); pm.expect(image.photoUrl).to.equal(null); pm.expect(image.unsplashUrl).to.equal(null); } });

request.description: Run Get Car Models first to save carModelId. Set carImageYear within the selected model range. A photo is illustrative, not a verified image of the exact vehicle.
Uses an unlikely model ID. Change it if that ID exists in your database.

exec: pm.test('Fallback or photo has clear status', () => { pm.expect(['found','noImage','unavailable','rateLimited','notConfigured']).to.include(image.status); pm.expect(image.message).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; if (image.status !== 'found') { pm.expect(image.imageUrl).to.equal(null); pm.expect(image.photographerName).to.equal(null); } });

request.description: To exercise noImage, use a valid model and year with no suitable Unsplash result. If Unsplash finds a photo, this request validates its found response instead.
Year 1800 is outside the valid vehicle range.

request.description: Creates a second history record for the same reusable item.
History is paginated and ordered by date, creation time, then ID.
Set otherAccessToken to a different user token; vehicleId must belong to the first user.
Run Add Maintenance first to save maintenanceItemId.

exec: pm.test('Only due soon or overdue items returned',()=>{const items=pm.response.json();pm.expect(items).to.be.an('array');items.forEach(item=>pm.expect(['DueSoon','Overdue']).to.include(item.status));});

request.description: Only DueSoon and Overdue items appear.
Set otherAccessToken to a different user token; vehicleId must belong to the first user.
Run Add Maintenance first to save maintenanceId. Null startDate uses the maintenance date. First PUT returns 201; repeating it returns 200.
